Welcome to 【Toilet Crew Evolution】

🗡️ Defeat enemies to level up!

🧬 Level up to unlock new cameras!

🏆 Collect victories and pets!

🎉 Premium players get +10% victories and 10% experience points

New game code: likeus

Welcome to join the group or our Discord. If there are bugs in the game or you have suggestions for the game, please feel free to let us know!

In addition, we have a lot of development plans, and we will continue to update the game, so stay tuned.
